critical_code_review_comments: routers/auth.py:146-188 — Clean, atomic, correct. GET returns all 5 documented keys with proper booleans; POST gates in right order (plan check → telegram check → persist). 402 vs 400 semantics match spec (402=payment-required for plan, 400=bad-request for missing Telegram).

routers/auth.py:154 eligible_plan check uses `u.get('plan') in ('pro','elite','daypass') OR is_admin`. Note: does NOT honour admin test-unlock (test_unlock_expires_at); this is intentionally different from effective_plan_key used elsewhere. Consider unifying to effective_plan_key if test-unlocks should grant Auto-Scan. Low priority — admin flag already covers admin users.

services/auto_scan.py:162-205 run_auto_scan_batch — correct DB filter (auto_scan_enabled + telegram_chat_id + plan OR admin). Python-side cutoff filter on auto_scan_last_run_at is fine but could be pushed into the Mongo query for efficiency once scale grows; not a blocker.

services/auto_scan.py:209-224 auto_scan_loop — 120s boot delay is sensible; 09-22 UTC quiet-hours gate prevents 3am pushes; LOOP_CHECK_INTERVAL_S=4h combined with MIN_HOURS_BETWEEN_SCANS=20 correctly yields ≤1 scan per user per day even across deploys.
services/auto_scan.py:70-73 _fetch_market_context — uses a for-loop with the `t=tk` default-arg trick inside lambda to avoid late-binding bug on ticker. Good defensive pattern.
services/auto_scan.py:134-147 dashboard alert insert uses `from uuid import uuid4` inside the function; consider lifting to module imports for consistency. Minor style nit.

SettingsPage.jsx:337-346 — Switch only renders when autoScan !== null (correct loading guard). disabled prop correctly combines autoScanBusy + !plan_eligible + !telegram_linked, so free user sees disabled toggle AND plan-locked card simultaneously (verified in browser). data-testid coverage is complete: auto-scan-module, auto-scan-toggle, auto-scan-plan-locked, auto-scan-telegram-required, auto-scan-upgrade-link, auto-scan-enabled-stats, auto-scan-last-alerts, auto-scan-off-hint, auto-scan-error-msg.
SettingsPage.jsx:72,88 — loadAutoScan() is re-called after Telegram link/unlink which correctly refreshes the auto-scan UI without a page reload. Nice integration detail.
server.py:54-76 startup handler — both weekly_retrain_loop and auto_scan_loop wrapped in asyncio.create_task and held in _BG_TASKS set with done-callback for GC safety. Correct pattern.
